newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African stocks end mixed, Stanbic falls.
newsitem.headline: S.African stocks end mixed, Stanbic falls.

text.p: 1420 GMT - South African shares shed small ground after subdued trade on Monday with Standard Bank shares hit by news New Age Beverages owes it 230 million rand.
* Industrials climb slightly from feeble start but finish off tiny highs. Golds dip throughout the day, weighed by a dull bullion price.

* Dealers say lack of interest hampering trade and market seen drifting sideways on Tuesday, awaiting direction from key local economic indicators due this week with April trade data due to kick off on Tuesday.

* Volumes traded 617 million rand as UK and U.S. markets closed for a holiday. Volumes boosted by an options exercise in Norwich which ended 14 cents weaker at 856 rand in a volume of over 75 million rand.

* SAB slips 75 cents to 127.25 rand on executive chairman Meyer Kahn's two-year secondment to the police service. Dealers say investors worried his involvement in SAB will decline as he takes up position of chief executive officer of the South African Police Services to fight crime.
* All-share index down 4.2 points to 7,067.5, industrials add 7.5 points to 8,319.6 and golds shed 3.1 cents 1,189.1.
